newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Statesville, N.C..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Statesville, N.C..

text.p: Sealed bids will be received by the Local Government Commission of North Carolina at its office in the Albemarle Building, 325 North Salisbury Street, Raleigh, North
Carolina 27603-1385 until 11:00 A.M., North Carolina Time,

such bids to be opened in public at said time and place on said day, for the purchase of the following bonds of the City of Statesville, North Carolina, dated December 1, 1996, and maturing (subject to the right of prior redemption) annually, June 1, as follows:
$500,000 WATER BONDS, SERIES 1996, $20,000 1998 to 2007 inclusive, $80,000 2008 to 2010, inclusive, and
$60,000 2011. $980,000 WATER AND SEWER BONDS, SERIES 1996, $30,000 1998 to

Copies of the Official Statement and the Notice of Sale and Bid Form relative to the bonds may be obtained from the Local Government Commission (919-733-3064). Each bid must be submitted on a bid form in the Notice of Sale and Bid Form.
